metric_limits.metal_current_allocated_size: Observed maximum across target-process Instruments rows; not a device physical-residency peak or exact transient peak.
metric_limits.driver_allocated_memory: PyTorch-polled current driver allocation; maximum sample may miss transients.
metric_limits.tensor_allocator_peak: PyTorch allocator peak for the stage; excludes other process and device allocations.
metric_limits.physical_footprint: Separate Activity Monitor pilot, sampled process physical footprint; not GPU-only and not simultaneous with six Game Memory captures.
metric_limits.resident_size: Separate Activity Monitor pilot, sampled process resident size; not GPU-only.
metric_limits.wall_time: Profiling and polling perturb host wall time; no timing result in this file is a performance benchmark.
